code='''def transform(grid):
    # Count T tetrominoes by whether the stem points up or down.
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); counts={3:0,1:0}
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<R and 0<=q[1]<C and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==2 and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            # Stem above the three-cell bar => color 3; below => color 1.
            if len(cells)==4:
                ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
                bar_y=next(y for y in set(ys) if sum(1 for yy,xx in cells if yy==y)==3)
                counts[3 if min(ys)<bar_y else 1]+=1
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    for color,n in counts.items():
        slots=[(0,0),(0,2),(2,0),(2,2)] if color==3 else [(0,3),(0,5),(2,3),(2,5)]
        for y,x in slots[:n]: out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
